decisions.reason: Strong early adoption and close fit with existing data integration capabilities give high absorptive capacity to keep improving the product.
Cyber security awareness training is close to the firm's training resources, so it can assimilate feedback and improve despite limited early visibility.
The profiling method has weak early results and faces regulatory and reputational barriers that limit the firm's ability to apply it commercially.
The travel and document verification platform has a dedicated webpage and builds on existing verification and security know-how, supporting ongoing learning and improvement.
